metric_definitions.peak_occupancy: Peak interval occupancy in measurement window (fraction)
metric_definitions.success_rate: Parked / drivers arriving in measurement window (fraction)
metric_definitions.target_occupancy_error: Time-weighted absolute gap from occupancy target (fraction)

low.uncertainty: 95% Student t intervals across seeds; paired differences use identical seeds. These intervals do not capture model uncertainty. Small seed counts are exploratory.
assumptions: Simulated outcomes; demand and behavior are not field calibrated.
Walking distance is a straight-line estimate, not an accessible pedestrian route.
Parking decisions occur on time-step boundaries; route time affects choice and is recorded separately from search delay.
Revenue accrues for occupied minutes at the hourly rate accepted on entry; stays are censored at simulation end.
